release_notes: 🔄 In-App Updater Fix: Fixed modal bottom sheet layout overflow across all screen sizes.
⚡ Resilient OTA Downloads: Added automatic HTTP Range resume across intermittent network drops.
🎨 Brand Identity Refresh: Clean transparent ribbon logo without background applied across app and admin console.
📝 MyDay Notes Experience: Samsung Notes–inspired editor with vector sketching, rich text formatting, checklist blocks, and audio/file attachments.
🔔 Smart Reminder Escalation: Configurable repetitive reminder escalation intervals and customizable reminder audio tunes.
📅 Calendar Integration: Unified view linking daily tasks, schedules, and reminders with monthly dot distribution.
📄 In-App Document Viewer: High-performance viewer supporting PDF documents and images with Android 'Open with' system integration.
